LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.Tip: Not all wounds are equal; set guidelines for which medicine to use when.
Prisoners in your colony, regardless of faction.
Animals which have been tamed by your colony.
Anything that doesn't fit into another category, such as guests or wildlife, will make use of these rules.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.Severity.Mi: Bruises, light bleeding, and other superficial injuries.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.Severity.Li: Life-threatening wounds, heart attacks, and near-fatal diseases.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.Severity.Op: Any and all surgical operations, regardless of type.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.Severity.Lo: Non-urgent illnesses that need regular tending, such as blood rot and gut worms. Also includes chronic conditions like asthma.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.DiseaseMarg:
Security margin used when treating diseases. 

If immunity is lower than disease progress plus this margin (and severity is higher than the minimum threshold), the disease is treated as a life-threatening injury.

For example, if a disease has progressed 75%, immunity is at 80%, and the margin is 10%, the disease will be classed as life-threatening. If the threshold was 5%, the disease would be classed as a major injury instead.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.DiseaseThre: Minimum severity before a disease can be classed as potentially lethal. \n\nIf severity is higher than this threshold (and immunity is lower than the severity plus security margin), the disease is treated as a life-threathening injury.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.MinorWounds: If the number of infection-causing wounds is greater than this threshold, they are treated as a major injury regardless of other factors. \n\nUseful to prevent 'death by a thousand cuts', where a large number of small cuts can cause multiple infections - and ultimately, death.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.SearchRadiu: Doctors will only search for medicine within this radius. If none can be found, they will use only whatever they have in their inventory.
LanguageData.Ceres.PharmacistReprescribed.Settings.To: Toggles visibility of the main tab. Settings will still be present; they just won't be visible.
